planets.name: TOI-7149 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-7149 with a 2.65-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-7149 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-7149. Its orbit and size follow Kanodia et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
